task_definition: For the known included primary reports, extract all source-grounded evidence requested by the external extraction protocol. Preserve the source-defined estimand, outcome, population or subgroup, follow-up, adjusted effect and confidence interval, model information, quantitative-usability status, and supporting location.
source_policy: Use only listed source documents. Target reviews and evaluator artifacts are forbidden.

representation_tracks.pdf_only: Obtain the listed publications separately. No PDF, OCR, or parsed text is redistributed.

evaluation.source_support: Evaluator adjudication with a source quotation
